page_title: AUX 0-0 LYO | Auxerre v Lyon 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+3' Great touch by Afonso Moreira (Lyon) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
90+2' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) will take the corner.

90+2' A sweet pass finds Afonso Moreira (Lyon) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Donovan Leon is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Lyon get a corner.
90+2' Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
90+2' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' The foul by Afonso Moreira (Lyon) was seen by Thomas Leonard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick to Auxerre.
89' The game has come to an end for Oussama El Azzouzi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
89' It will be a substitution. Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) is ready to enter the pitch as Lassine Sinayoko walks off.
87' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) picks up a yellow card.
85' Jorge Maciel prepares a substitution. Adam Karabec is replaced by Adil Hamdani (Lyon).
85' Gideon Mensah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
82' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
80' The ball is out of play. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner.
79' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
77' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Lyon.
73' The ball is out of play and Auxerre manage to earn a corner.

73' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
72' Substitution. Sekou Mara makes way for Josue Casimir (Auxerre).
71' Adam Karabec (Lyon) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
70' The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
69' A lofted cross from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
68' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner.
68' The referee points to the corner flag and Lyon will take a corner. Abner Vinicius (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
67' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up a caution.
67' Auxerre force their opponents to concede a corner.
67' Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.

67' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the top left corner is smartly dealt with by Dominik Greif. The ball goes out for a corner. Auxerre can continue in their attacking effort.
63' Jorge Maciel is forced to make a change. Clinton Mata is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon).
59' A neat pass is well received by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
56' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and it's Danny Namaso (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Lyon have a free kick.
55' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
55' The linesman makes the right call and Auxerre will have a corner.

53' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
53' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.
51' Adam Karabec (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

48' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Donovan Leon dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
46' Jorge Maciel makes a switch. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is coming on in place of Khalis Merah at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Thomas Leonard starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Adam Karabec (Lyon) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+2' Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
45+2' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a low shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Dominik Greif hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.

44' Martin Satriano (Lyon) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Auxerre have a free kick.
44' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
41' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle as Martin Satriano (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. There is a free kick near the sideline to Auxerre.
39' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
35' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' A clumsy foul by Kevin Danois (Auxerre) and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Lyon in a dangerous position.
33' Dominik Greif (Lyon) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
30' The game is interrupted now, Dominik Greif (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Adam Karabec (Lyon) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
28' The foul by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
26' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Auxerre.

26' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Dominik Greif leaps out to thwart his attempt. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Auxerre.
25' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is going to take the penalty!
25' Referee Thomas Leonard is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Auxerre!
24' Celebrations by Auxerre are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
23' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece. That is a penalty kick for Auxerre.
22' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
22' Adam Karabec (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

21' Donovan Leon makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Martin Satriano (Lyon) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
20' Khalis Merah (Lyon) has received a yellow card for his foul.
18' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
15' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Auxerre players look gutted.
15' Referee Thomas Leonard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
13' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
13' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
10' The Auxerre players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Adam Karabec (Lyon) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

7' Martin Satriano (Lyon) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom left corner of the goal. Donovan Leon displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
6' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
2' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard is the one to supervise the game today.
